item.title: Bulletin updated at 04:50 HKT 28/Jun/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A broad trough of low pressure will linger over the vicinity of the coast of southern China to the northern part of the South China Sea in the next couple of days. Meanwhile, under the influence of upper-air disturbances, there will be showers and thunderstorms over the region. With the upper-air disturbances departing, the weather will improve slightly and it will be very hot over southern China midweek next week.
